steps.code: curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash · npm i -g opencode-ai@latest

steps.en: Connect one or more providers and pick a model
steps.zh: 接入一个或多个 provider，选好模型

steps.en: Run it in your project and ask it to initialize
steps.zh: 在项目里运行它，让它初始化

steps.en: Analyzes the repo and writes AGENTS.md for later sessions
steps.zh: 分析仓库，写出供后续会话使用的 AGENTS.md

steps.en: Describe the change; Tab to the plan agent first, Tab back to build
steps.zh: 描述要改的内容；先按 Tab 用 plan 出方案，再按 Tab 回 build

steps.en: Reads, edits and runs shell commands under your permission rules
steps.zh: 按你的权限规则读文件、改文件、跑 shell 命令

steps.en: Feeds language-server diagnostics back to the model so it can fix the errors it introduced
steps.zh: 把语言服务器诊断回喂给模型，让它修掉自己引入的错误

value.en: The same agent workflow works with whichever provider or model you connect
value.zh: 同一套 agent 工作流，接哪家 provider、用哪个模型都照用

sources: packages/web/src/content/docs/index.mdx (/connect, /init creates AGENTS.md, Plan mode via Tab)
packages/web/src/content/docs/lsp.mdx (LSP diagnostics as feedback for the agent)
